root.label: FTC issues original Amazon Prime refund order

events.label: FTC issues original Amazon Prime refund order

slots.name: benefit limit
slots.sentence: The FTC's original order in September 2025 required only that Amazon refund customers who used fewer than 10 Prime benefits, such as free shipping, over the course of one year.

slots.name: settlement amount
slots.sentence: Of the $2.5 billion involved in the settlement, $1.5 billion was to be used on customer refunds.

slots.name: refund allocation
slots.sentence: Of the $2.5 billion involved in the settlement, $1.5 billion was to be used on customer refunds.

slots.name: payment cap
slots.sentence: At the time, the FTC said payments were capped at $51, but could be less than $1.

slots.name: settlement date
slots.sentence: The settlement came last year after Amazon was accused of using “deceptive methods” to register millions of customers for paid Prime subscriptions, then making it difficult for those customers to cancel.

slots.name: first payment date
slots.sentence: Some impacted consumers received automatic payments late last year as part of the agreement.
